group.ja: 温度制御・分子動力学

summary.ja: 熱浴を表す追加自由度と時間のスケーリングを導入する、決定論的な定温度分子動力学の出発点。
summary.en: Introduce additional heat-bath degrees of freedom and time scaling: a starting point for deterministic constant-temperature molecular dynamics.

caution.ja: 元の拡張Hamiltonianと実時間でのNosé–Hoover方程式を区別する。分布の不変性だけでは軌道のエルゴード性は保証されない。
caution.en: Distinguish the original extended Hamiltonian from the real-time Nosé–Hoover equations. An invariant distribution alone does not establish ergodicity.

references.label: Nosé (1984), A unified formulation of the constant temperature molecular dynamics methods
references.scope: Bibliographic entry and introductory comparison; full derivation and numerical reproduction have not been audited.

next_deliverable.ja: 専用の定式化・積分手順を整理し、固定入力、自由度・乱数・刻み幅を明記した分布と時間相関の検証例を追加する。
next_deliverable.en: Add a dedicated formulation and integration recipe, followed by explicit-input distribution and time-correlation checks with stated degrees of freedom, random seeds and step sizes.

limitations.ja: 比較解説を公開。Under construction：専用の実装・数値検証結果はまだありません。
limitations.en: Comparative reading is available. No dedicated implementation or numerical verification result is provided yet.

metadata_review.level: introductory comparison with primary-reference entry points; full derivation and numerical verification pending
